explainBack.question: Why doesn't picking a cute pet make ChatGPT's answers any better, and why might a quick chat seem to 'forget' my project files?
explainBack.answer: The pet is only an appearance layer drawn around the floating controls; OpenAI says selecting one changes how the panel looks, not how ChatGPT completes tasks, so the same model does the same work either way. Separately, any chat started from those floating controls begins outside a project, so it never receives the files and instructions saved there — the chat can only use the context the surface that starts it provides.
explainBack.expectedEvidence: An accurate answer must cite the appearance-versus-task-completion distinction (P003) and the floating-controls-outside-a-project boundary (P006), keeping both attributed to OpenAI's documentation.
explainBack.assessment: The article fully supports this causal answer in ordinary language; both links of the chain are explicit and correctly attributed, so explain-back passes.

unseenTransfer.scenario: A marketing director keeps her brand guidelines and tone instructions in a ChatGPT project. While reviewing slides in PowerPoint, she uses the floating pet controls to ask for a rewritten tagline and is annoyed that the reply ignores her brand voice entirely.
unseenTransfer.question: Using only this article's mechanism, why did the quick chat ignore her brand guidelines, and what should she do?
unseenTransfer.answer: Her quick chat started from the floating controls, which the article says begins outside any project, so the saved guideline files and instructions were never part of that chat's context. She should open the main ChatGPT app, start the chat from inside her brand project, and reserve the floating controls for requests that need no saved project context.
unseenTransfer.expectedEvidence: The resolution should rest on P006's context boundary and P009's principle that a chat can only use the context the surrounding product gives it, plus the article's stated remedy of starting from the project.
unseenTransfer.assessment: The scenario is absent from the article yet resolves completely from its mechanism and stated action, so unseen transfer passes.
